conventions.sha256: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON encoding (sorted keys, no spaces, ASCII escapes) of this entry's expected object
conventions.bytes: UTF-8 length of that same canonical encoding
conventions.kind: inline for hand-declared expected data; generated for seeded output reproducible from input.seed
conventions.cases: test case names registered by tests/data/commands, each exercised by a case whose name carries the full fixture id
conventions.values: the test source files that declare this fixture's cases; the cases themselves are the expected data, so the fragment holds no second golden table
conventions.diagnostics: a domain detail code is written data.<code>; a code the P1-004 kernel reports itself is written application.<code>, which plan 3.5 maps to the same outer error code
conventions.boundary: the slice of this fixture another task owns, and that task
conventions.minted: TYP-019, TYP-020, UNIT-014, ID-014, ID-015, ID-016, ALIGN-019 and ALIGN-020 are added by P2-004 under plan section 15, which lets an implementation task add fixtures that alter no existing expectation; none reuses or renumbers an id the plan 1.0 tables or another fragment declares
conventions.review_status: pending until the plan section 15 fixture review; the implementing task's independent reviewer is recorded in the task record
conventions.last_verified: the executed run that proved this entry, recorded by the owning task record's Validation table

fixtures.title: Cell edits and block pastes validate type, width, missing state and category

invariants: a cell edit publishes a successor version and the version it replaced stays readable with its values, metadata and identity unchanged
text into a numeric field, a blank into a field that declares no missing state, a fraction into an integer field and a value past the declared width are refusals that write nothing
an empty decimal payload and one that underflows the type to zero are refused, because a missing, error, NaN, infinite or empty text is never interchangeable with a value

the largest integer a width can name is refused by a float that cannot hold it exactly, and a decimal rounded past the signed bound is refused rather than stored as the boundary integer it did not name
a blank in a nullable field stores the missing state and never a zero
a category label outside the declared dictionary is refused instead of appended to it
an edit that states the value the column already holds publishes no object, no revision and no undo entry
a block paste writes from its anchor row and column, refuses a block reaching past the sheet or holding a value a target column cannot hold, and publishes nothing when no cell changes

fixtures.tolerance: exact value, storage type and state class; stable detail code with location
fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted
fixtures.boundary: formula recalculation over an edited cell is P2-005 and reopen is P2-006; this fixture covers the in-memory edit command path only

fixtures.title: A column type change previews an incompatible conversion or refuses it

invariants: a preview reports the same loss as the change it predicts and writes nothing at all
a narrowing that would drop a value is refused until the caller declares the round policy, and the declared policy then states what it rounded
a numeric column does not become a temporal one through a type change
a type change keeps the unit the column declares and refuses a target naming another one
a categorical relabel moves each value through its label and refuses a label the dictionary does not hold
a value the target width does not hold exactly is refused by the preview and by the change alike, so no successor publishes a number that reads differently from the version it replaced
a non-finite state keeps its class through the one spelling this family writes for it, whatever payload the bit form installed, and is refused by a field that holds only finite values
the declared round policy rounds a fraction and never turns an infinity or NaN into an integer the caller did not state

options.conversion_policy: reject unless the caller declares round

fixtures.tolerance: bit-exact for a preserved value; data.precision_loss naming source and target type
fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted

fixtures.title: The unit a column declares governs every value an edit writes

invariants: a value written in a convertible unit lands in the unit the column declares
a value in a unit of another dimension is refused rather than reinterpreted as a bare number
a unit on a value for a column that declares none is refused instead of dropped
an edit leaves the column's unit, role, display format and label alone
a conversion whose result leaves the range of the type is refused instead of published as an infinity

fixtures.tolerance: exact when the factor is representable, otherwise 1e-12 relative
fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted
fixtures.boundary: unit mapping at import is P2-003 and across save and reopen is P2-006; this fixture covers the unit the edit command reads and writes

fixtures.title: Insert, delete, move and undo rows and columns

invariants: an inserted row takes a new identity and undo restores the exact prior row domain and version identities and bindings
a redo re-applies the row edit and a fresh edit closes the redo branch
a column insert at a position renumbers the columns after it and undo restores the prior order with every binding identity
a declared column order names every column of the worksheet exactly once
an edit naming an identity the document still holds is refused before anything is published

fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted

fixtures.title: Submit a cell edit with a stale expected revision

invariants: an edit built against a stale expected revision is refused naming the revision it expected and the revision the object holds
the refusal publishes no version, no event and no undo entry
values, undo depth, published event count and last-action metadata are unchanged by it

fixtures.tolerance: exact; the refusal is the kernel's application.revision_conflict, which plan 3.5 maps from data.stale_revision
fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted
fixtures.boundary: the expected-revision check runs in the P1-004 kernel before the data handler, so the refusal carries the outer code and not a data.* detail; final code names stay inside plan section 14's open error-code registry decision owned by P1-004 and P2-002

fixtures.title: A row at a position after a move and an insertion

invariants: a row move reorders the domain without renaming a row, and each value travels with its own row identity
a cell edit after a move addresses its row by identity, not by the position first seen
an inserted row keeps the identity it was given and holds no value until an edit declares one

fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted
fixtures.boundary: sorting and filtering views, and the correspondence half of ALIGN-010, belong to P2-010; this fixture covers the row identity the edit commands preserve

fixtures.title: Undo, redo and repeat-last-action over one transaction contract

invariants: one undo reverses the whole transaction rather than one column of it and moves the entry onto the redo stack
a redo restores the edit under the identities it first used
repeating a cell edit that already landed states no difference and publishes nothing
a command that is not repeatable declines instead of issuing a second edit over identities the sheet now holds
an empty undo, redo and repeat each report the code that names which state is empty
the last-action record holds the transaction id and every revision its command produced

fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted

fixtures.title: One edit is one transaction and one event names every object it moved

invariants: a row edit publishes the worksheet, the revised row domain, each binding and each successor version in one revision and one event
the event's object list equals the revisions the outcome reports and each change is created or updated
a single-cell edit names only its binding and its successor version, and no other column of the sheet appears in the event
the subscriber is handed the same event the caller is told about

fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted

fixtures.title: No command reaches the document outside its declared write set

invariants: a command issued from inside an event listener is refused before it runs and publishes nothing
an object the caller did not declare in its expected writes cannot be changed by a command
no edit command mutates a published version: the result is a new version or a refusal

fixtures.tolerance: exact; the refusal names the object it reached outside its declared write set
fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted

fixtures.title: A row-shape edit rewrites every same-domain column in one revision

invariants: insert, delete, move and resize rewrite every same-domain column and the worksheet's row domain in one revision, so no reader sees a column ordered by the domain the sheet left
a new row gains the missing state in every column and a shrink drops the tail of every column
role, unit, display format, label and order index belong to the binding and survive a row edit
a resize that grows without new identities, a block covering rows it does not introduce and a position past the last row are refused naming the bounds
a move bounds its run by subtraction from the row count, so a start and length that add past the width of that count are refused rather than wrapping into a move that moves nothing
an edit that states no difference publishes no object and spends no identity

fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted

fixtures.title: A mirror binding is read-only at every edit command

invariants: a cell set, a block paste, a type change and a row-shape edit over a sheet holding a mirror are refused with the read-only diagnostic
the refusal publishes no version and changes neither the mirror nor the binding it aliases
the mirror keeps aliasing the source column's version identity after the refusal

fixtures.platform_scope: macOS 14.4+ Apple Silicon executed; other targets unexecuted
fixtures.boundary: mirror propagation, cycles and source deletion (ALIGN-007 to ALIGN-018) belong to P2-010; this fixture covers only the read-only refusal at an edit command
